[quote=baladullah;59808704]As salaamu alaikum. Yes, I agree that there are situations in which war may unfortunately be necessary; to end a genocide, to end brutal persecution, and the like. But peace and diplomacy are, in my view, preferable to military options until they have been entirely exhausted. 

In regards to the possibility of nuclear warfare, audhubillah (I seek refuge from Allah, sorta like God forbid). No matter how awful or brutal a country has been, the use of nuclear weapons is never justified and is just collective punishment, in my opinion. I urge all parties involved to restrain themselves and remove the nuclear option from the table.

I must reiterate that IPEA is open to all nations to join, provided they are  not currently involved in aggression against other nations. Also, if any warring parties want a third party to help them negotiate peace, this is the organization to assist with such matters, in shaa Allah.[/quote]
Thank you Sultan Masud al-Ayyubi.

I think it is time to talk about the [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation]-[nation]Sikirsk[/nation] war because it is very large scale, the largest I've ever seen land-wise. At least besides the [nation]Enkia[/nation] war, which is, like I said actually why we founded IPEA, to stop another [nation]Enkia[/nation] like war. There more than 1 billions of people at risk. If IPEA doesn't act fast all will be lost.

Also there is the [nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation]-[nation]United Hydronia[/nation] war, Western View was created soon after it started and I have not heard about it in a long time but i do know that IPEA is at the ready if it gets out of hand.

I would lastly like to state that i believe IPEA members shouldn't have nukes, if they do they will have to get rid of them, if they don't get rid of their nukes they will be ejected, but that is just me and I would have to go over it with [nation]Sovereign Republic of Velmara[/nation] and [nation]Baladullah[/nation], so what do you think Supreme Chancellor Anika Rau?

[quote=sikirsk;59807234][spoiler=Below...]

(I will from now refer to the Kaiserreich as TK)

After somewhat sad defeat of Sikirskian forces, Sikirsk has now refreshed its doctrines. The following will mostly surround naval.

Before the start of the war, the immenent threat of the Kaiserreich was expected and mutiple ultra-stealth Yasen-class Submarines entered 
the deep, command gave greenlight of Operation: Kingfish. With the now present TK blockade around the island, and with impending naval defense systems armed and ready on their side, we must now find something new, although only a small fleet of airplanes was used in the situation earlier, those were, with stealth on, now retreating to [b]REDACTED[/b].

Sikirsk had encrypted their naval programs of creating these submarines, totally free from external knowledge.

Anyways...

Okhotnik-B drones got dispatched, spotting the TKS Seelöwe, armed with loitering munitions to potentially strike before, the loitering munition: Lancet-3M was used en masse to swarm the enemy beforehand. AA hits were taken, first dodged, then hit. Hits on carrier werent confirmed. Although Carrier location now revealed.

Submarine "Sibor" together with "Juunn" Submarine, both Yasen-class, had already left along with others. Both armed with hightech P-870 Onikski supersonic anti-ship cruise missiles, aswell as 3M-54 Kalibr Anti-Ground-Naval Missiles. The first very good against carriers, the latter best all-round. And as a special for the "Juunn" submarine, also included one Sikirsk's newest weapons, the 3M22 Zircon with Mach-9 Percision capability. SLCMs are being used into full usage. Before much happend on the seas, Sibor fired a large group of decoy torpedoes towards one of the further away Cruisers of the TK Navy, TKS Seelöwe Carrier was now in range, and now Juunn fired their 3M22 Zircons at the TKS Seelöwe, with Mach-9 reached within kilometers, nearing Mach-10, the missiles rapidly approached the aircraft carrier, which was still pretty worn out from the drone ambush while staying low to avoid detection and if any AA fire. Outcome I cant decide, very likely to be hit.
[/spoiler]

I absolutely agree about nuclear weapons. They are dangerous, highly destructive and easy ways to kill million some of innocent civilians at once. If the THEP is creating them,it means trouble for all of us, but I dont think we need to focus on it just yet, but semi must always be ready.

With [Nation]United Hydronia[/nation]-[Nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation], not much news has been heard from there in a long time, but we must always be on guard. This issue is interesting because Sal-Baliz is a terrorist group who attacked the THEP, who are known to have been building nuclear weapons. But, nothing for now.

The TK and Sikrisk war. It is happening directly south of my island, and it is disturbing the populace. From the sounds of it, TK made an aggressive invasion of Sikrisk due to not wanting foreign powers in Elysr. I partly disagree with this, as we are all linked in one global society now, although I havent had an updated of the status of the people. In my opinion, peace is still possible and we should focus on trying to contact both nations.

Finally, I wish to invite another nation into this alliance. [Nation]Asyla Socialists[/nation]. A while back, so Ive been told, they faced a rebellion terrorist group named the EIRA (Extreme Islamic Rebels of Asyla). I believe they can positively contribute to this alliance.

But I want to here your views, what do you think, Sultan Masud al-Ayyubi?
